title: The covenant between us and them is prayer; so, whoever abandons it has disbelieved
hadeeth: Buraydah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) said: "The covenant between us and them is prayer; so, whoever abandons it has disbelieved."
attribution: Narrated by At-Tirmidhi, An-Nasā’i, Ibn Mājah, Ahmad
explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) pointed out that the covenant and pledge between the Muslims and the disbelievers and hypocrites is prayer. So, whoever abandons it has become a disbeliever.
hints: The Hadīth shows the great status of the prayers and that they are the distinguishing feature between the believer and the disbeliever.
The rulings of Islam are established based on the outward circumstances of people, regardless of their inward circumstances.
hadeeth_intro: Buraydah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him) said:
hadeeth_ar: عن بريدة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «إِنَّ الْعَهْدَ الَّذِي بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمُ الصَّلَاةُ، فَمَنْ تَرَكَهَا فَقَدْ كَفَرَ».
hadeeth_intro_ar: عن بريدة رضي الله عنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم:
explanation_ar: بَيَّنَ النبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أنَّ العهدَ والميثاقَ بين المسلمين وبين غيرهم من الكفار والمنافقين الصلاةُ، فمَن تَرَكَها فقد كَفَر.
hints_ar: عِظَم شأن الصلاة، وأنّها الفارق بين المؤمن والكافر.
ثبوت أحكام الإسلام بالظاهر من حال الرجل دون باطنه.
attribution_ar: رواه الترمذي والنسائي وابن ماجه وأحمد
